messages:
samir: Quick handoff: ran narrowband bring-up for sparrow-9b-int6 vs our 11B baseline. Short summary and recommended pilot plan.

nora: go ahead with numbers pls

samir: bench snippet (short interactive slice, avg 2.4 turns):
```
baseline-11b-fp16: cost/req $0.0118, p50 86ms, p95 340ms, QA-EM 72.6%
candidate-sparrow9b-int6: cost/req $0.0071, p50 90ms, p95 385ms, QA-EM 71.0%
```
Cost down ~40%, EM down 1.6 pts, p95 +45ms cold. Cache hit ~20% in this slice.

teo: product asked for a microbudget cutoff and latency ceiling for pilot. Proposed values?

samir: suggest microbudget $0.0085/request and p95 ceiling 420ms for interactive GTN pilot. Candidate meets cost, p95 slightly under ceiling when blended safety routing applied.

nora: safety/regression notes? any language slices flagged?

samir: small calibration regression on one Spanish style slice (more literal paraphrases), found 0.6% of traffic but surfaced by our synthetic probes.

teo: mitigation options?

samir: three quick ones: 
- classifier routing of flagged prompts to baseline (~0.8% traffic)
- post-filter for paraphrase-tightening (cheap but may reduce fluency)
- keep candidate for low-risk intents only initially

nora: recommend classifier routing for pilot to keep UX deterministic. What is blended cost after routing?

samir: classifier recall 0.92 at 0.4 thresh, FP ~0.7%. Blended cost = 0.992*0.0071 + 0.008*0.0118 = $0.00714 -> still under microbudget.

teo: rollout plan?

samir: Draft: canary 1% non-sensitive traffic, monitor EM on production slices, p95, and classifier FN. Ramp to 25% over 6 days if metrics stable. Rollback triggers: EM drop >3 pts OR p95 > 440ms sustained 30m OR safety FN incidents >1/24h.

nora: add cost guardrail: if spend per-unique-user for pilot cohort goes up >10% vs baseline, pause ramp.

opsbot: canary image built (infer-sparrow9b-int6:2026-11-16-rc1). Canary config saved at /deploy/canary/3965432100-sparrow9b.json

samir: uploading S3 slice + short README with bench CSV and classifier model link. Will add CI microtests: EM delta <3.0 pts and p95 cold <440ms on nightly run.

teo: good. schedule canary start 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll wire alerts.

nora: thanks Samir 44d no objections from product.

samir: will post updates in this thread as canary runs.
